_comment: Per-trail settings for tools/build_legs.py. 'lines' are the route-line versions (from build_map_geojson.py) to cut into legs. 'referenceLine' is the one landmarks are snapped to for the lat/lon stored in the trail JSON. 'overrides' maps a landmark name (exactly as in trail-data) to {"query": "..."} (a better Nominatim search, e.g. the town's bridge rather than the town), {"interpolate": true, "why": "..."} (place it between its neighbours by table mileage), or {"point": [lat, lon], "why": "..."} (a hand-set position; put it on the path).

Dorney Lake.why: the lake is 2 km long and inland of the path

Kennet Canal / Reading.why: the Kennet mouth is not named in OpenStreetMap

Cholsey.why: the village is 1.5 km from the river

Dorchester.why: the village is 800 m from the river

Water Hay Car Park.why: not in OpenStreetMap by this name

Source of the Thames.why: start of the official GPX line, at the Thames Head stone
